cassia.predicted_cell_type: Excitatory / glutamatergic neuron (deep-layer cortical projection neuron)
strengths: Correctly identifies the core excitatory/glutamatergic lineage from HTR2C, GRM4, GRM8, PCP4, CHRM2, NXPH2, SEMA3E, CRYM, CALCRL.
Provides detailed marker-functional reasoning and explains vascular/ECM-like genes (ERG, CD36, ITGA8, COL8A1) as part of the deep-layer excitatory neuron signature.
Uses negative evidence to argue against glial, endothelial, and immune identities.
weaknesses: Subtype-level label is not mappable to a single unambiguous CL in the frozen ontology context.
Distinction between L5/6 NP, L5 ET, and L6 CT/L6b relies on negative marker evidence and is not fully resolvable from the provided top-DEG list.
Over-specific relative to the confirmed ontology-valid granularity.

strengths: Correct broad neuronal lineage supported by multiple neuronal markers (HTR2C, PCP4, NXPH2, CHRM2, SEMA3E, CRYM, CALCRL).
Maps cleanly to a valid ontology identifier CL:0000540.
weaknesses: Top1 label is under-specific; it misses the supported glutamatergic/excitatory refinement available in the marker set and enrichment signature.
Its own rank2 glutamatergic neuron (CL:0000679) is better aligned with the original evidence.

strengths: Exactly matches the best-supported ontology-valid descendant of the observed neuronal identity.
Supported by GRM4, GRM8, HTR2C, PCP4, CHRM2, NXPH2 and the Lake et al. Ex6 excitatory neuron enrichment signature.
Maps cleanly to CL:0000679 with deterministic ontology mapping.
weaknesses: Does not capture possible deep-layer cortical subtype specificity.
Canonical vesicular glutamate transporters (SLC17A6/SLC17A7) are absent from the top marker list, and some ECM/vascular-like genes lower confidence.

supporting: Top DEGs include HTR2C, GRM4, GRM8, PCP4, CHRM2, NXPH2, SEMA3E, CRYM, CALCRL, ETV1, supporting a neuronal glutamatergic/excitatory identity.
Enrichment-based Lake et al. Ex6 excitatory neuron signature and PMID 35642195 directly support glutamatergic neuron identity.
In-house rank2 and enrichment both map to CL:0000679 glutamatergic neuron, providing an ontology-valid majority-supporting target.
conflicting: Canonical vesicular glutamate transporter genes SLC17A6/SLC17A7 are absent from the top marker list.
Top DEGs include vascular/ECM-associated genes (ERG, CD36, ITGA8, COL8A1, COL12A1, ADAMTS12) that create uncertainty for deeper subtype assignment.
Deep-layer subtype distinction (L5/6 NP vs L5 ET vs L6 CT/L6b) is not resolvable to a single ontology-valid CL from the provided evidence.
enrichment_or_literature: Lake et al. Science Ex6 excitatory neuron signature; GPCR signaling enrichment terms (hsa04080, hsa04082); PMID 35642195 supports human cortical excitatory neuron identity.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
